mapper.select: SELECT o.order_no, o.member_id, m.member_name, o.order_state, o.total_amount, o.ordered_at FROM ORDERS o JOIN MEMBERS m ON o.member_id = m.member_id WHERE o.del_yn = 'N' AND o.order_no = #{orderNo}
SELECT i.order_no, i.line_no, i.sku, p.product_name, i.qty, i.unit_price FROM ORDER_ITEMS i JOIN PRODUCTS p ON i.sku = p.sku WHERE i.order_no = #{orderNo} ORDER BY i.line_no
SELECT d.delivery_no, d.order_no, d.delivery_state, d.invoice_no, d.shipped_at FROM ORDER_DELIVERY d WHERE d.order_no = #{orderNo} ORDER BY d.shipped_at DESC, d.delivery_no DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ORDERS (order_no, member_id, order_state, total_amount) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{memberId}, #{orderState}, #{totalAmount})
INSERT INTO ORDER_ITEMS (order_no, line_no, sku, qty, unit_price) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{lineNo}, #{sku}, #{qty}, #{unitPrice})
